faq.headline: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS.
faq.subtitle: Answers to questions that hold companies back from implementing AI.

cost.question: Is AI implementation expensive?
cost.answer: We don't start with large investments. First, we identify processes that consume the most time and money. On average, companies save 20+ hours per week after the first implementation. That's ROI in 2-3 months. A free audit will show you exactly how much you can save in your company.

fitBusiness.question: Will AI work in my company?
fitBusiness.answer: AI is not a universal solution. That's why we always start with an audit of your processes. If there are repetitive tasks, data handling, or integrations between systems in the company - AI will work. We don't implement solutions where they won't bring value. If something doesn't make sense, we'll tell you straight.

complexity.question: Is it complicated and time-consuming?
complexity.answer: We do implementation in iterations. We start with one process, test it, then scale. The first implementation takes 2-4 weeks, not months. The system adapts to your processes, not the other way around. You work as before, the system works in the background.

control.question: Will I lose control over processes?
control.answer: On the contrary - you gain more control. You get full documentation, real-time dashboards, and the ability to modify at any time. The system belongs to you. You can change it, scale it, or turn it off whenever you want. Zero dependency on an external provider.

mistakes.question: What if AI makes a mistake?
mistakes.answer: Every system undergoes testing in real conditions before full deployment. Additionally, we set up safeguards - alert systems, verification mechanisms, human-in-the-loop where needed. AI supports decisions, doesn't replace humans at critical moments. You have full control and real-time monitoring.

time.question: I don't have time for implementation now.
time.answer: Paradox: lack of time is exactly why you need automation. The audit takes 5 minutes. After that, you know how much time you can recover. The first implementation requires 2-3 hours per week for 2-4 weeks. Then the system works for you 24/7. It's a time investment that pays back many times over.

waiting.question: Maybe I'll wait until technology develops?
waiting.answer: AI already works in thousands of companies. Every month of waiting is lost hours and money. Competition doesn't wait. Technology is mature - we use proven solutions, not experiments. The sooner you start, the bigger advantage you'll build.
